Has distributed-systems, caching, async/concurrency, and production troubleshooting experience transferable to platform automation.
main_gaps: The required 3+ years of platform/SRE/database-reliability experience and on-call operational ownership are not evidenced.
Production Go plus hands-on operation of Kafka/Cassandra/Aerospike/Redis-style data platforms are not clearly demonstrated.

entries.title: Part-Time Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Product Architect
top_match_reasons: Some relevant full-stack, cloud deployment, testing, and architecture exposure.
Candidate has experience with AI-enabled applications and production reliability practices.
main_gaps: This is an executive CTO/product-architect role requiring ownership of company-wide technology strategy, team leadership, and MVP delivery.
Child-safety/privacy architecture and compliance leadership, including COPPA, are not evidenced.

entries.title: IT Cloud Web Application Platform Engineer
top_match_reasons: Directly relevant cloud-platform foundations: AWS ECS/Fargate deployment, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux, monitoring, and reliability testing.
Backend engineering experience supports collaboration with application teams and building automation for hosted services.
main_gaps: Minimum requirement of 2+ years of IT infrastructure experience is not clearly met by the early-career resume.
The posting excludes temporary-visa holders and candidates needing current or future sponsorship; candidate work authorization is not provided.

entries.title: Software Engineer, C — Codebase Q&A Evaluation
top_match_reasons: Strong evidence of debugging, regression testing, and 90+ unit/integration tests in production and evaluation systems.
LLM-evaluation platform work is directly relevant to assessing AI-generated software outputs and documenting failures.
main_gaps: No demonstrated professional C experience, despite the role's C-specific code-review scope.
The role asks for strong day-job engineering judgment comparable to senior reviewers.

entries.title: Founding Engineer - Mobile + SaaS Fitness Platform
top_match_reasons: Strong hands-on full-stack, backend, cloud, CI/CD, testing, and production-reliability experience.
Has worked on production knowledge applications and can make evidence-based tradeoffs in APIs, retrieval systems, and deployment.
main_gaps: Founding-engineer scope requires demonstrated ownership of mobile/SaaS product architecture, production launch, and technical leadership/hiring beyond the resume's early-career sco
Native mobile development and health/wearable-platform integrations are not evidenced.

entries.title: Specialist Solution Engineer
top_match_reasons: Candidate has technical AI, data, and rapid-prototyping experience that could support analytics demonstrations.
Experience building production applications and communicating evaluation results offers some transferable technical credibility.
main_gaps: This is a customer-facing technical sales and business-development role, rather than a hands-on software or AI implementation-engineering position.
Required Salesforce and Tableau/CRM Analytics experience is not evidenced.

entries.title: Software Engineer, Go — Codebase Q&A Evaluation
top_match_reasons: Demonstrated debugging, automated regression testing, and substantial unit/integration-test development.
Relevant LLM evaluation experience and clear evidence of reviewing model behavior through golden sets and evaluation harnesses.
main_gaps: No Go experience is evidenced, while strong day-job Go experience is a core qualification.
The expected code-review judgment is framed around experienced engineers reviewing unfamiliar production Go code.

entries.title: IT AI Engineer II
top_match_reasons: Direct hands-on experience building production RAG, agentic workflows, MCP tool calling, evaluation systems, and AI API services.
Strong evidence of production readiness through AWS deployment, CI/CD, observability, regression gates, and guardrails.
main_gaps: Requires six-plus years of IT/software, applied-AI, data-engineering, or automation experience; the resume shows substantially less.
Enterprise Microsoft-stack integration requirements, including Azure/Fabric, Dataverse, Copilot, and Power Platform, are not clearly evidenced.

entries.title: Software Engineer II Data Reliability & Automation (APIs)
top_match_reasons: Demonstrated backend/API development, AWS deployment, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, testing, and observability work.
Reliability-oriented production work includes tracing, structured validation, regression tests, caching, and staged deployments.
main_gaps: Requires 3+ years in platform/SRE/database reliability; resume shows early-career software experience rather than this depth of operational ownership.
Production Go and stateful data-platform operations (e.g., Kafka, Cassandra, Aurora, failover/recovery) are not clearly evidenced.
